# enums

> Enumerations and bit flags: enum Color(red, green, blue) and flags Perm(read, write, exec).

[source](../../registry/enums.pkg) · truck

```
use std
use enums

enum Color(red, green, blue)
flags Perm(read, write, exec)

print Color_name(green)     // green
print Perm_name(read | exec) // read|exec
```

| package | declares |
|---|---|
| `enums/enum` | constants 0, 1, 2, ... and `<Name>_count`, `<Name>_name`, `<Name>_parse`, `<Name>_valid` |
| `enums/flags` | constants 1, 2, 4, ... and `<Name>_count`, `<Name>_all`, `<Name>_name`, `<Name>_parse` |

Both expand into `const` and `fn` declarations, so they work with every
backend. The names are ordinary constants: use them in `match`, `if`,
arithmetic and other constants.
